method: Public list membership plus recursive trees/READMEs and selected core-source review; not an audit of every source file or runtime test of all repositories.
license_note: GitHub API metadata is an inventory hint, not asset relicensing. No detected license means no reuse permission inferred. No external starred source/assets vendored.

repositories.integration_decision: Historical mission context only; README says collection stopped in June 2025. No terrain heights or local traversability.

repositories.scope: e-Yantra image-guided arena and bridge/cavity task
repositories.integration_decision: Competition abstraction; overhead image maze is not a measured 3D Mars surface. No import.
Reviewed tree contains only README; described Java implementation is absent. No runnable planner to integrate.
Habitat suitability is not rover-scale collision navigation; avoid treating generated environment scores as measured terrain. Defer.
UI/route abstraction; no demonstrated measured rover-scale terrain/sensor contract. No source import.

repositories.scope: MOLA DEM terrain-cost A* and other search algorithms
repositories.integration_decision: Adopt terrain cost as an independently implemented idea. Reject hardcoded 463 m spacing, NaN-to-mean and block averaging for local hazards.
Model-dependent rollouts are promising after steering/slip calibration. No license detected; no code copied. Defer.

repositories.scope: Cooperative informative planning for scout and rover, ROS/C++
repositories.integration_decision: Adopt known/unknown observation distinction as an independent method. Full ROS1/scout stack is outside the current Python-only stage.
Two-file tree mostly documentation; no validated DEM/sensor/planning pipeline to integrate.
Graph routing is not local 3D hazard evaluation. GPL source not imported.
Retain standard search concept only; independent metric A*, hard constraints and exact-goal validation implemented here. No source copied.
Useful algorithm teaching reference; binary grids lack measured Mars geometry and sensor timing. No import.

repositories.scope: Motion-primitive A* and arc tracker, Pygame
repositories.integration_decision: Independently implement short-command arc/corridor checks. Its procedural bumps/rocks are not imported as real Mars terrain.
Not a demonstrated UE geometry/sensor adapter. No code/data import.
Web route abstraction; no measured local height/collision contract. No import.
Metadata and byte-order discipline are relevant. Global 128 px/degree MOLA is approximately 463 m sampling, unsuitable for wheel-scale obstacles. No import.
Source provenance and directed-cost concepts are relevant; inspected terrain is 12 m, not wheel-scale. Complex asset licensing and native/prototype distinction retained. No source/assets imported.
Image class is not elevation or clearance. Defer perception research until labeled rover imagery/calibration are available.
System-scale forcing/power/throughput screening, not local rover navigation. No import.
Context only, no local terrain/sensor/planner implementation. No import.
Potential mission context; does not establish rover-scale collision geometry or native UE driving. No import.
Geological/global context only; resolution and registration must be respected. Not the local navigation surface.
Landing-site suitability is distinct from footprint/step clearance. General hard/soft criteria concept only; no scores imported.
Hydrology and random starting points are not rover collision planning. No claim that this source fills pits; no algorithm/data copied.
Reviewed tree contains only README; no executable model/pipeline to integrate.
Useful broad-context visualization; no verified wheel-scale DEM/native collision/sensor path. No import.

repositories.scope: MARSIS radar formats and GIS/array conversion
repositories.integration_decision: Subsurface radar is not the surface microtopography required for rover collision. GPL source not imported.
Adopt map/goal/provenance separation in our own small UI. Viewshed is line-of-sight analysis, not a rover path planner. No MMGIS code/assets imported.

repositories.scope: GIS viewer with planetary basemap sources
repositories.integration_decision: planets.rs supplies Web Mercator planetary raster basemaps; not a fine DEM. Do not use Earth tile metres as Mars local distances.

repositories.scope: Isaac Sim Mars scenes and sensor/optional ROS2 bridge
repositories.integration_decision: Adopt capture stamp, organized-point and applied-setting verification as independent adapter practices. Scene-generation tools absent and engine differs; no source/assets imported.

repositories.scope: EXONAUT adaptive risk planning and synthetic environments
repositories.integration_decision: Retain distinction between terrain prior and evidence. Slip/energy/Bayesian/RL models need calibrated data and are deferred. No learned policy or procedural terrain imported.

repositories.scope: Real-data lunar terrain classes and risk-aware A*
repositories.integration_decision: Adopt hard-constraint versus cost distinction independently. Its 8/15/25 degree classes are explicitly provisional and not rover-certified Mars limits. No code copied.

repositories.scope: Earth field dataset for Mars-analogue rover sensing
repositories.integration_decision: Useful later calibration/timestamp validation dataset, explicitly Earth analogue rather than measured Mars. No assets imported.

repositories.scope: UAV survey, boustrophedon coverage and visual landmarks
repositories.integration_decision: Aerial coverage is distinct from skid-steer rover footprint/collision planning. Defer coverage features.

repositories.scope: Current Unreal project, TCP rover and sensor plugins
repositories.integration_decision: Direct integration uses existing LIDR/NAVF plugins, measured DEM import and motor protocol; runtime plugins made explicit and shared clock/wire contract reviewed.
Algorithm reference for separated planning/tracking responsibilities; independent implementation, no source copied.
Informative exploration may later complement a rover; different vehicle/stack, not imported.

repositories.scope: Calibrated stereo/SGBM, obstacle map and planning
repositories.integration_decision: Independently implement paired capture, SGBM metre depth and transform into the map. No external calibration or source copied.
Potential future vehicle/model reference; user CAD/kinematics are separate and no model imported.
Presentation context, not native 3D rover clearance. No import.
Human/settlement simulation is outside the local geometric driving task. No import.
Different project/engine and runtime contract; no direct drop-in navigation integration demonstrated. No import.
2D image arena, not measured Mars DEM. No public separate İKA list was visible; this relevant star was reviewed individually. No source copied.
Different vehicle and sensing assumptions; no demonstrated measured Mars rover integration. No import.
